headline: Executive order lets the U.S. freeze property of certain people and groups tied to the situation in Burma (Myanmar).
what_it_does: This order sets up sanctions related to events in Burma. "Blocking property" generally means that money and property of targeted people or groups that is in the U.S., or held by Americans, is frozen and cannot be used or moved. Americans are generally barred from doing business with those targeted. The title alone does not say exactly who is targeted or why.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations connected to Burma who are named under the order
who_it_affects.how: Their property and money under U.S. control can be frozen, and they can be cut off from dealing with Americans.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. banks, businesses, and individuals with ties to Burma
who_it_affects.how: They may have to freeze targeted assets and stop doing business with anyone listed under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 10, 2021; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed, but the title alone does not confirm the start date.
